%%
%% Additional packages beyond what acmart v2.16 already provides.
%%
%% acmart already loads: hyperref, xcolor, graphicx, booktabs, fontenc (T1),
%% caption, float, framed, amssymb, natbib, geometry, microtype.
%% Do NOT reload those here to avoid option clashes.
%%

\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning}
\usepackage{colortbl}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{ifdraft}
\usepackage{algorithm}

\usepackage{checkend}	% better error messages on left-open environments
\usepackage{graphbox}   % for alignment of figures in includegraphics
\usepackage{subcaption}
\usepackage{multirow}
\usepackage{tabularx}	% an enhanced tabular environment
\usepackage{wasysym}    % used for annotations
\usepackage[printonlyused]{acronym}
\usepackage{framed}     % for statusbar environment in annotations
